## Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD status | Policy on PQ | Additional safety |
|---|---|---|
| **G6PD Normal** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg over 7 days or PQ 0.25 mg/kg over 14 days or tafenoquine (pilot) | No information |
| **G6PD Intermediate** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg over 7 days or PQ 0.25 mg/kg over 14 days | Close medical supervision |
| **G6PD Deficient** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg weekly for 8 weeks | Strict medical supervision |
| **If no testing available** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg weekly for 8 weeks | Close medical supervision |

## Notes

I would like to share an update on the malaria program in Afghanistan. The program revised the National Treatment Guidelines (NTG) in 2025 and introduced a short course of primaquine for the radical treatment of P. vivax cases. Additionally, there are plans to pilot the use of tafenoquine in one of the malaria high-burden provinces.
